Japanese in a Flash! looks up Japanese words, readings, meanings, and example sentences.
Practice, study sets, and reminders are not in this version yet.

Dictionary entries come from JMdict (EDICT), the property of the Electronic Dictionary Research and Development Group (EDRDG). They are used, converted, and modified under the Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 licence (CC BY-SA 4.0). The modified dictionary data is shared under the same licence.
Core 1000 is not a separate word list. It is the cards whose JMdict entry carries the nf01 or nf02 frequency tag from the Mainichi Shimbun, under the same CC BY-SA 4.0 licence.
Example sentences are from the Tatoeba Project (originally the Tanaka Corpus) and are used under the Creative Commons Attribution 2.0 France licence (CC BY 2.0 FR).
